acceptance.behavior: The login recovery link opens /reset-password, which supports both reset-email request and authorized password-update states.
The responsive recovery route provides labeled email, new-password, confirmation, progress, error, and completion states without browser alerts.
A successful recovery uses Supabase Auth to replace the account credential, after which the old password fails and the new password authenticates.
The password-update form is exposed only after Supabase accepts a recovery code or establishes a password-recovery session.
The acceptance spec writes the required exact-revision desktop, mobile, trace, accessibility, and PBOS result artifacts.
One Playwright journey validates recovery request, secure-link handoff, validation, credential replacement, desktop, mobile, and accessibility behavior.
Recovery controls use programmatic labels, keyboard-visible focus, announced statuses, and reject serious or critical axe violations on mobile.
Request responses do not reveal account existence, provider errors are not exposed, passwords must match and meet length policy, and the recovery session is signed out after success.
